name: Driving Licence (Sarathi / Parivahan)
department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
description: Application for learner's licence, driving licence, and renewals through the Parivahan Sarathi portal.
benefits: Legal authorisation to drive; valid identity/address proof.
processing_time: Learner's licence same day (online test); DL after driving test, ~7-30 days.
validity: 20 years or until age 40 (whichever earlier), then renewable.
office_locator: Regional Transport Office (RTO) locator on Parivahan.
ai_summary: Driving Licence (Sarathi / Parivahan) is a central government service under Ministry of Road Transport and Highways in the Transport category, available both.

name: DigiLocker
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Cloud-based platform for issuance and verification of documents and certificates in digital format.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with an Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
benefits: Access to authentic digital documents (DL, RC, marksheets, PAN) legally at par with originals.
ai_summary: DigiLocker is a central government service under National e-Governance Division in the Digital Services category, available online.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: Single-window platform for students to apply for various central and state government scholarships.
eligibility: Students meeting scheme-specific income, category and academic criteria.
benefits: Financial assistance for tuition, maintenance and other academic expenses via DBT.
processing_time: Scheme-dependent; verified by institution and department.
ai_summary: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is a central government service under Department of Higher Education in the Education category, available online.

name: PAN Card (Permanent Account Number)
description: PAN is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier issued for all tax-related and high-value financial transactions.
eligibility: Individuals, companies, HUFs, and entities carrying out financial transactions in India.
benefits: Mandatory for filing income tax returns, opening bank accounts, and high-value transactions.
processing_time: e-PAN via Aadhaar: instant to 10 minutes; physical card: 15 days.
fees: Instant e-PAN free; regular PAN Rs.93 (Indian address) + GST.
ai_summary: PAN Card (Permanent Account Number) is a central government service under Income Tax Department in the Finance category, available online.

name: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing
description: Annual filing of income tax returns by taxpayers through the e-filing portal.
eligibility: Individuals/entities with taxable income above the exemption limit or seeking refunds.
benefits: Legal compliance, tax refunds, income proof for loans/visas.
processing_time: Refund processing: typically 7-45 days after e-verification.
fees: Free filing; late fee up to Rs.5000 under Section 234F if after due date.
office_locator: TRP (Tax Return Preparer) locator on portal.
ai_summary: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing is a central government service under Income Tax Department in the Finance category, available online.

name: Udyam Registration (MSME)
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Free online registration for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises to obtain a Udyam Registration Number.
eligibility: Any micro, small or medium enterprise (manufacturing or services) as per turnover/investment criteria.
benefits: Access to collateral-free loans, subsidies, priority sector lending, and government tenders.
processing_time: Instant to a few days; registration certificate generated online.
ai_summary: Udyam Registration (MSME) is a central government service under Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in the Business category, available online.

name: Aadhaar Enrolment / Update
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identity number issued to residents of India based on biometric and demographic data.
eligibility: Any resident of India, including infants and children, regardless of age or gender.
benefits: Universally accepted proof of identity and address; enables access to subsidies, benefits and services (DBT).
processing_time: Enrolment: up to 90 days for Aadhaar generation; updates: 30 days.
fees: First enrolment free. Demographic update Rs.50, biometric update Rs.100 (as notified).
ai_summary: Aadhaar Enrolment / Update is a central government service under Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) in the Identity category, available both.

name: Passport (Fresh / Reissue)
description: Issuance of Indian passport for international travel through the Passport Seva online portal.
eligibility: Indian citizens. Minors apply through parents/guardians.
benefits: Internationally recognised travel document and proof of Indian citizenship.
processing_time: Normal: 30-45 days; Tatkaal: 1-3 working days (post police verification norms).
fees: Rs.1500 (36 pages, normal) to Rs.3500+ (Tatkaal); varies by pages/type.
validity: 10 years for adults; 5 years or until age 18 for minors.
office_locator: Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) / Post Office PSK locator on portal.
ai_summary: Passport (Fresh / Reissue) is a central government service under Consular, Passport and Visa Division in the Identity category, available online.

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Direct income support of Rs.6000 per year in three instalments to eligible landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Landholding farmer families, subject to exclusion criteria (income tax payers, institutional landholders excluded).
benefits: Rs.6000/year paid directly to bank accounts via DBT.
office_locator: Common Service Centres (CSC) / village revenue officers.
ai_summary: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi is a central government service under Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare in the Agriculture category, available both.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Ayushman Card)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Health assurance scheme providing up to Rs.5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
eligibility: Families identified as per SECC deprivation criteria / eligible categories.
benefits: Cashless treatment up to Rs.5 lakh/family/year at empanelled hospitals.
processing_time: Ayushman card generation: instant to a few days after eligibility check.
office_locator: Empanelled hospitals & Ayushman Mitra desks; CSC centres.
ai_summary: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Ayushman Card) is a central government service under National Health Authority in the Healthcare category, available both.

name: e-Shram Card (Unorganised Workers)
description: National database registration for unorganised workers providing a Universal Account Number (UAN) e-Shram card.
eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16-59 not covered under EPFO/ESIC.
benefits: Accidental insurance cover and access to social security schemes.
processing_time: Instant card generation on successful registration.
ai_summary: e-Shram Card (Unorganised Workers) is a central government service under Ministry of Labour and Employment in the Labour category, available online.

name: Income Certificate (Maharashtra)
description: Certificate stating the annual income of a family, issued through Aaple Sarkar / MahaOnline for various welfare and scholarship purposes.
eligibility: Residents of Maharashtra requiring proof of family income.
benefits: Required for scholarships, fee concessions, reservations and welfare schemes.
processing_time: 15 working days (as per RTS Act service standard).
ai_summary: Income Certificate (Maharashtra) is a state government service under Revenue Department in the Certificates category, available online.

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate (Maharashtra)
description: Certificate confirming that the applicant is a permanent resident of Maharashtra, issued via Aaple Sarkar.
eligibility: Persons residing in Maharashtra for the qualifying period as per rules.
benefits: Required for education admissions, government jobs and domicile-based benefits.
validity: Generally lifetime / as accepted by the requesting authority.
ai_summary: Domicile / Residence Certificate (Maharashtra) is a state government service under Revenue Department in the Certificates category, available online.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: State scheme providing monthly financial assistance to eligible women residents of Maharashtra.
eligibility: Women aged 21-65 residing in Maharashtra, meeting income and other criteria as notified.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance credited via DBT to eligible women.
processing_time: Verification-dependent; benefits via DBT after approval.
office_locator: Anganwadi centres, Setu, CSC, ward offices.
ai_summary: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana is a state government service under Women and Child Development Department in the Welfare category, available both.
